$comment: Manifests Sextant accepts and refuses, shared by the SDK's validator (sdk/scripts/manifest.mjs, sdk/test/manifest.test.ts) and Sextant's own check (parse_manifest in crates/sextant-core/src/extensions/manifest.rs). A case is `bases[base]` with every JSON pointer of `set` set (an object gets the key; an array gets the item at that index replaced, or appended when the index is its length) and every pointer of `remove` removed. A refused case names the field (`path`, empty for the whole file) and a part of the message.
